goal: Version 2.4.0 of the package is published to npm; done when reports/publish.txt shows the published version and the approval is on file

steps.title: Bump the version and write the changelog
steps.proof: package.json says 2.4.0 and CHANGELOG.md has a 2.4.0 section listing every merged change

steps.title: Run the full test suite
steps.proof: reports/tests.txt holds the npm test output with 0 failures

steps.title: Update the docs for 2.4.0
steps.proof: npm run docs:build succeeds and every new option in CHANGELOG.md appears in docs/

steps.title: Build the package
steps.proof: npm run build exits 0 and npm pack --dry-run lists dist/index.js

steps.title: Approve the release
steps.proof: reports/approval.md records yes or no, the approver and the date

steps.title: Publish to npm
steps.proof: reports/publish.txt holds the npm publish output and npm view shows version 2.4.0
